name: web-weather-voice-must-search
description: The Voice Assistant, a new conversation, a rambling spoken weather question (a tester's voice chat, 2026-10-23; the town is fictional). A model on this PC must search first (tool_choice "required"), but llama.cpp's grammar lets Qwen3.5 write an answer before its call: Yap never shows or says that text, and a step that writes on is cut short and searched for. Right: the search runs, the answer comes from the pages (°C). Run with --locale en-GB; the transcript shows each forced step's words.

results.title: Kellbrook Weather Today | Forecastly
results.text: Today in Kellbrook: cloudy with light rain from mid-afternoon, high 12°C, low 7°C, wind SW 14 km/h. Tonight: showers easing, 8°C.
